slices.title: "Always" as reviewed revocable rule (MCP rows)
slices.summary: An Always choice on an MCP tool approval becomes a proposed rule that the user confirms in settings. Confirming writes a digest-pinned user-scope allow (mcp_tool only, ceiling external_write, never owner_effect); built-in tools never offer Always. Rules expire (90 days default, 365 max), digest drift demotes them to ask, and create, confirm, use and expiry each write a content-free tool_policy_rule_* audit row.

K3-10: expiry (90 days default, 365 max) and content-free tool_policy_rule_* audit rows are asserted

slices.title: Enforcement: policy client, mode and rung caps, lockdown, extension allow-lists
slices.summary: Makes the org policy bind: the gateway reads it through a cached client (30 s TTL; stale-if-error bounds of 900 s after a restrictive answer and 120 s after a permissive one, then typed 503 org_policy_unavailable for Do runs); the mode resolves against the cap with lockdown refused as mode_lockdown; rung grants clamp to the rung cap; and capability-core hides and denies MCP servers and tools outside the org allow-list (org_extension_not_allowed). Behind ORG_AGENT_POLICY_MODE (off/shadow/enforce) and ORG_EXTENSION_ALLOWLIST.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p model-gateway org_agent_policy
